technical_and_design_decisions: Build the software modules as standalone Spring Cloud Stream / Spring Integration application starters targeting Java 17 and Spring Boot 3.x.
Utilize 'spring-integration-websocket' for the WebSocket Source module to handle inbound browser event channels.
Leverage 'spring-integration-aws' extension and AWS SDK v2 for S3 and SES integrations in both Source and Sink modules.
Use Spring Data Cassandra and the DataStax Java Driver for high-throughput data writing in the Cassandra Sink.
Implement HAWQ Sink using Avro/Parquet serialization utilities and Spring JDBC/PXF stream interfaces.
Utilize Solr Java Client (SolrJ) for batch document indexing in the Solr Sink module.

Implement a centralized Error Channel messaging framework using Spring Integration advice chains to intercept exceptions, extract 'Caused by' details, format error payloads, and route to the specified error channel.
assumptions: Development environment includes Java 17+, Docker/Testcontainers for local setup of Cassandra, HAWQ, Solr, and LocalStack (AWS simulation).
Existing CI/CD pipeline and artifact repository infrastructure are available for module publishing.
Third-party libraries (e.g., spring-integration-aws) are compatible with the target Spring Framework 6 / Spring Boot 3 base.
A single full-stack Java developer will perform end-to-end implementation, unit/integration testing, and technical documentation.

activities.activity_description: Analyze user stories, design common module interfaces, establish project templates for source/sink modules, and configure build dependency management.
Implement the WebSocket inbound channel adapter, auto-configuration properties, payload converters, unit tests, and integration tests using embedded WebSocket server.

activities.activity_name: U2: AWS Source Module Implementation (S3 & SES)
activities.activity_description: Implement S3 event-driven/inbound file synchronizer and SES email ingestion adapters, configuration binding, unit tests, and integration tests with LocalStack.
Implement Cassandra outbound channel adapter with dynamic query generation, batching support, configuration properties, unit tests, and Testcontainers-based integration tests.
Implement S3 outbound channel adapter for direct stream/file uploads, bucket/key expression evaluation, auto-configuration, unit tests, and LocalStack integration tests.

activities.activity_name: U5: HAWQ Sink Module Implementation (Avro/Parquet via PXF)
activities.activity_description: Implement HAWQ/PXF outbound sink with Avro and Parquet schema serialization, write buffers, configuration properties, unit tests, and integration tests.
Implement Solr indexing outbound channel adapter supporting single/batch document commits, auto-configuration, unit tests, and integration tests using Testcontainers Solr.

activities.activity_name: U7: Configurable Error Channel & Exception Routing
activities.activity_description: Implement exception handling hierarchy (GlobalException, DefaultException, ModuleSpecificException), exception unwrapping logic, payload formatting, error channel routing, and testing with HTTP source ingest.

activities.activity_name: U8: Data Partition Strategy State Preservation Testing
activities.activity_description: Design and execute integration test suites verifying data partition state stability during dynamic module addition and deletion across stream pipelines.
Perform full pipeline integration testing across source/sink combinations, write user guides and reference docs for each module, and package release artifacts.
